purpose: Public-parameter 2RC conditional voltage benchmark; not full paper reproduction or capacity identification
lineage: Published parameters are fitted from pulse data; author WLTP is a reference validation experiment, not a new independent confirmation set
known_prior: Read author scripts, parameter ranges and source quality, no model prediction errors computed
Author demo uses SOC0 .99 and cropped tail; this protocol does not use that demo
Author paper build references separate single-temperature files absent from fixed tree; extracted 25C rows of public combined tables are not asserted identical

data.time_resolution: integer seconds with duplicate rows; actual subsecond times unknown
data.current: Use original ordered duplicate-time source arrays via numpy.interp, positive discharge; do not deduplicate input
data.voltage_reference: At every integer second 0..79057 inclusive, last raw voltage in source order; original duplicates remain preserved
data.demo_csv: Not used; current differs from raw workbook by up to .7790062 A under last-row alignment
data.temperature: Use author 25C isothermal assumption; measured 23.7..26.1C only context

parameters.lookup: Author model uses PCHIP in SOC for extracted single-temperature tables; no extrapolation

solver.evaluation_times: all integer seconds; t_eval does not change adaptive stepping

methods.B_R0: Same current, OCV, capacity, SOC trajectory and R0; remove only RC polarization terms; no measurement feedback

decision.comparison: 2RC adds benchmark evidence only if full finite coverage and lower MAE and RMSE than R0
decision.absolute_usefulness: No use-case absolute error tolerance justified yet; no field deployment or 90% acceptance claim
decision.stop: One frozen evaluation; no tuning SOC, parameters, time alignment, window or method after errors. If solver/domain fails, report failure without crop/clip/extrapolation

reproducibility.meaning: Numerical reproducibility tolerances only, not physical accuracy
